loadError: Couldn't load projects. Is the server running?

list.emptyBody: Add the folders that hold your models in Settings and scan them, or create a project by hand.

form.name: Name
form.sourceUrlHint: A MakerWorld, Printables or Thingiverse link, or any web address.
form.descriptionFileHint: With a file chosen, the project info below is loaded from it and saved back to it. With none, the text stays in the app only.
form.newFileHint: A Markdown file is created in the project folder with the text typed so far, and picked as the project info file.
form.newFileExists: A file with this name already exists there.
form.writeError: Couldn't write the project info file. Check the folder and try again.
form.previewFileHint: The model shown first on the project page. Automatic picks the newest project file.
form.galleryHint: Add images from the project folder. SVG, PNG and JPEG.
form.galleryEmpty: No images selected yet. Add some from the list below.
form.galleryPickFolder: Pick a folder to see its images.
form.coverAuto: Cover: automatic (a picture named like a cover, else the plate preview)
form.folderHint: Optional. Full path of a folder with the model files; they are scanned right away.
form.editedHint: Fields you change here are kept when the folder is scanned again.
form.error: Couldn't save the project. Check the folder path and the link.
form.numberHint: Leave empty for the folder’s number, or the next free one.
form.numberTaken: Another project already has this number.
form.createInHint: A folder named after the project is made there. Upload its files on the next page.

folder.title: Project folder
folder.none: This project has no folder yet. Create one named after the project, or link a folder that already has its files.
folder.unlinkText: The project will have no folder. What happens to {{from}}?
folder.unlinkMissingText: The folder isn't there any more, so nothing on disk changes. The project forgets its files and print setup.
folder.changeText:
The project moves to {{to}}.
What happens to {{from}}?
folder.trashUnlinkHint: The folder and all its files move to {{trash}}. They stay there until you empty the trash in Settings → Projects. The project forgets its files and print setup.
folder.trashChangeHint: The folder and all its files move to {{trash}}. They stay there until you empty the trash in Settings → Projects.
folder.moveLabel: Move its content to the new folder
folder.moveChangeHint: Everything in the current folder moves into the new one, and the empty folder is removed. The project starts fresh in the new folder (slice again if needed).
folder.keepUnlinkHint: Nothing on disk changes, and the project keeps everything it knows. Scans leave the folder alone, so it doesn't come back as a new project. Link the same folder again later and the project is back as it was.
folder.keepChangeHint: Nothing on disk changes, and scans leave the folder alone, so it doesn't come back as a new project. The project starts fresh in the new folder (slice again if needed).
folder.kept: Unlinked from {{path}}. The folder was kept as it was, and scans leave it alone.
folder.trashed: Moved to {{path}}. It stays there until you empty the trash in <settings>Settings → Projects</settings>.
folder.noRoots: To create a folder, first <settings>set up a project folder</settings>.
folder.missingTitle: The project folder was not found
folder.missingText: {{path}} was deleted, renamed or is offline. Recreate it, link the folder where the files are now, or unlink it.
folder.error: Couldn't change the project folder. Try again.

errors.outside_roots: That folder is not inside one of your project folders.
errors.folder_in_use: Another project already uses that folder.
errors.folder_exists: A folder with the project's name already exists there. Link it instead.

remove.title: Delete {{name}}?
remove.body: The project is deleted. This can't be undone.
remove.bodyFolder: The project is deleted, and its folder too if no file is left in it. This can't be undone.
remove.bodyKept: The project is deleted. This can't be undone. Its kept folder {{path}} is no longer skipped: the next scan finds it as a new project unless you move it out of your project folders.
remove.error: Couldn't delete the project. Try again.

errors.project_has_prints: It has prints. Move them to another project, or to No project, first.
errors.project_in_order: It is part of an order. Remove it from the order first.
errors.folder_has_files: Its folder still has files. Move or delete them first, or the next scan finds the project again.

viewer.label: 3D preview of {{name}}
viewer.failed: The 3D preview could not be loaded. Showing the thumbnail.
viewer.tooLarge: This model is {{size}} MB, over the {{limit}} MB 3D preview limit (change it in Settings). Showing the thumbnail.
viewer.unsupported: This file type has no 3D preview.

detail.ownerReadOnly: Owner: {{name}}. You can view and download this project, but not change it.
detail.galleryLeftOut_one: {{count, number}} picked image is too large to keep from the device and isn't shown.
detail.galleryLeftOut_other: {{count, number}} picked images are too large to keep from the device and aren't shown.
detail.setUpHint: No estimate yet. Set up and slice the print to see it.
detail.slicedNoData: Sliced, but the slicer saved no estimate

openFailed.no_slicer: Set up a slicer in Settings > Integrations first.
openFailed.not_allowed: This file is outside your project folders.

slicing.title: Print setup
slicing.hint: Pick the plates one print of this project takes, and the print profile and filaments for each.
slicing.autoSlice: Slice again when the file changes
slicing.autoSliceHint: Re-slices the sliced plates with this setup when their 3MF changes. If the change adds or removes plates or filament slots, you get an alert instead.

state.outdated: The file changed since this setup was saved
state.missing: Not in the file any more

slicing.sliceHint: Slices the plates that were never sliced or changed since, with each plate's slicer.
slicing.noSlicer: Set up a slicer in Settings > Integrations to slice.
slicing.upToDate: Every plate is sliced and up to date.

error.not_allowed: This file is outside your project folders.
error.no_preset: “{{detail}}” isn't one of this slicer's presets: it's hand-made, or another slicer's. Import it from this slicer, pick another profile, or pick another slicer.
error.empty_plate: Plate {{detail}} has no objects in this file. Add some in the slicer and save, or remove the plate.
error.unknown: The slicer failed. See the server log.
error.no_machine_preset: No printer preset for “{{detail}}”. Import its model's printer presets from the slicer (Settings > Integrations).
error.no_printer_profile: The printer “{{detail}}” has no default print profile. Pick a print profile for this plate, or set one on the printer.

slicing.slicerHint: Plates without their own slicer use this one. If it's switched off, they use the default slicer.
slicing.filamentFromFile_one: {{names}} isn't a {{slicer}} preset: this plate slices with the file's filament for it. Its price still counts.
slicing.filamentFromFile_other: {{names}} aren't {{slicer}} presets: this plate slices with the file's filaments for them. Their prices still count.
slicing.presetMisfit: {{slicer}} has no preset for “{{name}}”, so this plate won't slice. Pick another slicer, or profiles imported from this one.

files.dropHint: Drop files here to upload them, or onto a folder to upload into it.
files.name: Name
files.folderHint: Folder names can't contain \ or : or start with a dot.
files.renameHint: Pick a name that isn't used in this folder.
files.moveHint: Pick the folder to move it into.
files.deleteHint: It moves to the trash folder of the project root. Empty it in Settings > Projects.
files.exists: A file or folder with this name already exists.
files.tooLarge: The file is over the upload limit (Settings > Projects).
files.error: That didn't work. Check the name and try again.
